description: Forge 1.20.1 rendering library for highlighting entities and blocks with outlines, fills and animations

mods.name: Highlight API
mods.description: library mod that adds support for custom highlights and outlines for blocks, entities, and regions.

releases.notes:
## What's New
- Initial Release

## API Usage
```java
HighlightAPI.create(Lifetime.ETERNAL)
    .setTarget(entity)
    .setOutlineColor(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f)
    .setFillColor(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.3f)
    .setDepthMode(DepthMode.IGNORE)
    .register();
```

## Installation (JitPack)
```gradle
repositories {
    maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
}
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.github.NOIST1611:HighlightAPI:v1.0.0'
}
```

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.x
